Our personalised car word art print celebrates a passion in style: a rounded classic car in pale blue, filled with a name and a list of words you choose. It's a great birthday, Christmas or team gift.

Create a personalised car word art print in two boxes

Fill in two boxes: the name, which sits once prominently in the design, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as teams, clubs, nicknames, achievements and favourite moments. We repeat the words randomly in different sizes, fonts and shades across the design, and the preview shows what you've typed next to the print photo.

Keep to single words or short phrases (three words at most), separated by commas, and leave out emoji, icons and accented letters. We print exactly what you type, so read it through once more.

Why you'll love it

  • Ready to display: A3 frames have a clip on the back for hanging, and A4 frames have a stand
  • One of a kind: every word comes from you, so no two prints are the same
  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • The name stands out once, and your other words repeat in different sizes, fonts and shades

Size & details

  • Design: a rounded classic car in pale blue, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised car word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.
